items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was that pitcher? Ron Durant or something like that? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm. I don't remember.

ctx.x: So, my eyes began to fool me and I began to get hit. I had to quit. Yeah. My nose has been broken from being hit right in the face with a baseball because I misjudged. And the doctor told me that even one of these days you're going to get your brains knocked out, he says, your eyes are not far anymore.
Who was that pitcher? Ron Durant or something like that? They say he wore bottle caps for glasses. And all the batters were afraid of him for some reason.
